Two files register handlers for `member.joined` via `subscribe(...)` from the event bus (`src/lib/event-bus.ts`), both wired up in `src/server/services/event-registry.ts`:

- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` (line 89) — imports repository modules `organization-repository.ts` and `usage-repository.ts`.
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts` (line 231) — imports repository modules `issue-repository.ts`, `notification-repository.ts`, `organization-repository.ts`, and `notification-preference-repository.ts`.

The union of repository files directly imported by these two handler-registering files is: `organization-repository.ts`, `usage-repository.ts`, `issue-repository.ts`, `notification-repository.ts`, `notification-preference-repository.ts`.
